comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body:
Okay kiddies, settle down. Here's what I can tell you without throwing insults:

silver tarot cards work fabulously on equipment that has 100 dura or more. You don't get "world" every time, but it comes up often enough to keep that equipment in pristine condition. You can dungeon forever in Lima and end up having to sell silver tarots because you'll get more than you can use. And your HIGH dura gear (100+) will never be in danger of going away.

Now fur boots? That's a problem, the silver tarots will NOT keep up with that or anything else that has around 50 dura. Quit hurling insults and just tell people what you know.. They don't have to believe you, it doesn't make it any less true.

comments.author: Theo
comments.body: yea, the world is really a very good effect for equip more than 100 dura but the downside of 3 hours wait is too much and even more if you draw wrong tarot.

comments.author: When zhi
comments.body: What i'm trying to say is even with the 3 hour wait and even though "world" is one of four results from a silver tarot card, you can get the effect enough to keep high dura items from deteriorating. I'm not guessing or thinking maybe it works, i'm telling you from experience it works. It works well enough that I have never had to buy mtt's or mst's, ever. I HAVE had to remake my high def boots tho, it just can't keep up with that.
